answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.20 → 2.21 overview
answer_card.answer_md: The ansible-core **2.21** porting guide lists behaviour changes since **2.20** that may require updates to playbooks, plugins and other content. Read it together with the ansible-core 2.21 changelog.
